subject: Hackathon brief - Saturday 22 March 2031
text:
Hi team,

Locking the basics for our 4-hour build day (Quellworks Build Day 2031):

- Date: Saturday 22 March 2031, 10:00 to 14:00 (4 hours, 240 minutes).
- Participants: 48, in teams of 4.
- Core staff on site: 4 (the organising team). They eat lunch with everyone.
- Volunteers on site: 4 (registration desk and runners). They are on site all day but are NOT in the meal count.
- Every room we use must have a projector for demos.
- Run of show: 15 min opening, 30 min lunch, judging at the end, 15 min closing. All remaining time is build time.

As organiser I have the final say on headcount, timing, budget and approvals. Ora Pim handles money.

Xavi Quell
Organiser, Quellworks Build Day 2031
